prompt: Create a new original landscape background concept for a Sega Mega Drive startup splash, using the reference only for its deep-navy and faceted-cyan crystal language. Background plate only: absolutely no text, letters, logos, symbols, typography, UI, or wordmark. Preserve a broad, calm, nearly black negative-space area across the center for a large future logo, especially the central 60 percent of the canvas. Improve the composition by moving the luminous focal point off the exact center: use an energetic diagonal current that travels from the lower-left edge toward the upper-right perimeter, with its brightest crystalline flare kept beside the logo safe area, never behind the center of the future logo. Build asymmetrical, bold crystal clusters along the outer edges: a strong upper-left facet cluster, a shorter lower-right cluster, and sparse accents near the opposite corners. Keep most rays and shards outside the central safe area; only a few fine cyan guide streaks may point inward and fade before reaching the logo area. Large readable polygon facets, crisp hard edges, saturated electric blue/cyan with restrained pale-cyan highlights, dark navy shadows, no fog, no soft bloom, no starfield, no tiny noise, no gradients, no mirror symmetry. Designed to translate cleanly to 320x224 tile-based 16-bit pixel art, with distinct silhouette groups and room for parallax.
